lessons.title: The Linux Filesystem Tree 🌳
lessons.description: Understand the hierarchical structure: root, home, and the big picture.

lessons.title: Navigating with cd 🧭
lessons.description: Move between directories using absolute and relative paths. Master `.`, `..`, and `~`.

lessons.title: Listing Files with ls 📋
lessons.description: Unlock the power of `ls` with `-l`, `-a`, `-h`, `-R` and more options.

lessons.title: Creating & Removing Directories 📁
lessons.description: Build and tidy up your filesystem with `mkdir`, `rmdir`, and safe cleanup.

lessons.title: File Paths & Globbing 🗂️
lessons.description: Work with absolute and relative paths, and use wildcards to match files like magic.
